summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a 6-K on September 21, 2026, attaching a Hong Kong announcement covering modified resumption guidance, additional findings from an independent forensic and supplemental investigation into possible related-party transactions, results of an internal control review, and continued suspension of trading in its Hong Kong-listed shares (Stock Code 6623) and NYSE ADSs (LU). No price, stake, or premium terms are stated. The exchange's guidance, first received March 21, 2025 and modified per an April 24, 2026 letter, requires remediation and compliance demonstration. Watch resumption timing, regulatory integrity concerns, and any further delisting risk.
